The following is the list of information typically included in the vision:

Stakeholders and Concerns

Defines any stakeholder concerns about the business and the exercise (i.e., development and implementation of a target architecture) being undertaken

List of issues/scenarios to be addressed

Defines the business context and problem description for which the vision of the target architecture has been produced. This clarifies:

  • Business vision statement for the target architecture
  • Pictorial representation of business context
  • Change drivers and opportunities behind this vision for the target architecture

Business Vision Diagram

Provides a suitable pictorial representation(s) that explain the business context and business problem. They are required to obtain senior executive engagement with this activity.
This clarifies:

  • Diagram(s) explaining the problem statement for the target architecture
  • Description of business vision diagram

Change Drivers & Opportunities

Identifies the reasons behind this vision for the target architecture. This clarifies:

  • Change drivers that will impact decisions made for the target architecture
  • Opportunities that can be leveraged for the target architecture

Detailed Objectives

The purpose of the detailed objectives is to identify the needs to be fulfilled by the target architecture. Previous sections look at the business problem whereas this section determines the objectives for the architecture solution that will resolve the business problem. This clarifies:

  • Business objectives to resolve the business problem
  • Technology objectives such as decommissioning

Process Description

Outlines the business processes that are in scope and thus impacted by the target architecture. This clarifies:

  • Business processes that are in scope for the vision
  • If required, high level diagram(s) of business processes
  • Descriptions for the business process diagrams

Process Steps Mapped to Business and Technology Environments

Acts as a cross reference between the in-scope business processes and the business and technology environments. This clarifies:

  • Business environment in scope for the vision
  • Technology environment in scope for the vision

Constraints

Describes the constraints that impact the target architecture.

To serve as a key tool used for selling the benefits of the proposed target capabilities to the stakeholders and decision-makers within the organization.

To agree at the outset what the desired outcome should be for the architecture, so that architects can then focus on the critical areas to validate feasibility.

To support stakeholder communication by providing an executive summary of the target architecture.

To make sure that the impact on current architecture is understood such that gaps and subsequent change can be subsequently assessed and implemented.
